problem.title: Ever read a horoscope and wondered why it fit someone else but not you?
problem.lead: The answer usually comes down to scope and presentation, not who is more skilled.

point1.title: Different scope
point1.copy: Each framework — Zi Wei, BaZi, astrology — looks at its own structure and answers its own set of questions, not your whole life in one line.

point2.title: Different language
point2.copy: Classical terms need someone to translate them into how people actually talk today — otherwise you just hear the sound, not the meaning.

point3.title: Hard to compare
point3.copy: An insight is only truly useful when you can see the data and the rule behind it, not just hear the conclusion and take it on faith.

problem.bridge: Lá Số Việt starts with Zi Wei: it builds your actual chart first, then opens each insight so you can check it yourself — instead of handing down one verdict and stopping there.

faq.title: Common questions about Lá Số Việt

q1.question: Does Lá Số Việt use AI?
q1.answer: Yes. AI helps structure and clarify prose strictly within computed evidence rules without replacing astronomical calculations.

q2.question: What if I do not know my exact birth time?
q2.answer: You can still generate a chart using a 12 Earthly Branches interval. When time is completely unknown, limitations are explicitly stated.

q3.question: Do paid reports renew automatically?
q3.answer: No. All in-depth reports are one-time payments tailored to your selection, with zero recurring charges or subscriptions.

q4.question: How is my birth data protected?
q4.answer: Your birth details are private by default. Guest session data is permanently removed after 24 hours unless linked to an account.

q5.question: What is included in the free chart?
q5.answer: You receive the complete 12-palace astrological chart, three core destiny highlights, and verifiable evidence sources.

q6.question: Does the reading cite evidence sources?
q6.answer: Yes. Key findings directly reference star placements, interacting palaces, and transparent classical interpretation rules.

q7.question: Who edits the interpretations?
q7.answer: All interpretations are edited by Lá Số Việt using exact astrological algorithms and curated traditional scholarship.

q8.question: Can I revisit my chart later?
q8.answer: Yes. By saving your data or signing in, your generated chart and unlocked readings remain securely accessible in your library.
